title: Societal and technological progress as sewing an ever-growing, ever-changing, patchy, and polychrome quilt
reasoning: The paper is a theoretical exploration of AI ethics and alignment, specifically arguing for a framework that accommodates persistent moral diversity and value pluralism. It explicitly uses religious examples (Christianity and Buddhism) to illustrate irreducible differences in basic ontology and values, and it critiques the pursuit of a single universal ethical 'truth' for AI systems.
